meta.note: Separate 128k measurement on a different host, excluded from the best-round aggregate. Prefill is one full call; decode medians pool 4 x 16 calls. Sequence totals are retained separately.

sequence_definition: Sum of all individually synchronized timed forward calls in each fresh-cache repetition; includes capture, growth and all decode steps; excludes cache creation and inter-call checks. Aggregate is sum of per-case arithmetic means. This is not continuous generate latency. The legacy summary uses pooled decode medians and is not a complete sequence-cost estimator.
